trigger: The precommitted binary alarm was evaluated on cached through-0.5-percent artifacts. At 0.5 percent it alarmed only for GLM, but replacing all corroboration with the answerability fallback removed two correct direct corroboration decisions. No 0.75- or 1-percent counter-retrieval evidence report had been generated or scored when this amendment was recorded.
provenance: This is transparent post-label method refinement on previously opened development claims. It is not confirmation even though the 0.75- and 1-percent counter reports are prospectively collected relative to this amendment.

normal.condition: posterior predictive upper-tail probability greater than 0.01
normal.action: Use the selected loose-direction leave-original-out corroboration blend.

warning.condition: posterior predictive upper-tail probability at most 0.01 and greater than 0.0001
warning.action: Use only unopposed direct leave-original-out corroboration; otherwise retain the answerability fallback.

critical.condition: posterior predictive upper-tail probability at most 0.0001
critical.action: Disable retrieval-based overrides and use the answerability fallback.

rationale: The environment statistic changes the evidence standard rather than declaring individual passages poisoned. A warning calls for stronger independent evidence; a critical clean-model violation makes retrieval overrides too risky. The 0.01 and 0.0001 cutoffs encode one-in-100 and one-in-10,000 clean posterior-predictive budgets rather than nominal attack rates.

rate_extension.activation: All same-model RAG/internal-majority disagreements at each rate.
rate_extension.retrieval: Reuse each original claim-generated question plan; exclude all original document IDs and exact texts; no provenance-based filtering.
required_reporting: RAG, memory, answerability, loose corroboration, strict corroboration, and tiered gate by model and rate
all new calls, tokens, failures, retries, and counter-view poison exposure
clean and 0.1-0.5 percent replay under the tiered policy
the selected low-rate candidate remains unchanged until fresh confirmation
